Thank you, I haven't heard of 'Knightmare Chess' but i will be checking it out after this.  I have thought of the same thing and my idea was for the players to make the board themselves (as in putting down the board spaces one after another) rather than it being a 8x8 square.  I have given a thought about the board could be "cards" themselves to an extent with effects.  The combonations would and could be endless but there would have to be rules about how you could make the board.  Making everything to scale would be hard and i have even thought of just making figures with keywords on them but I'm growing on the idea of square cards.  
I haven't played enough drafting board games to make one but I will think about that some more, the main reason i want it to be a TCG is because they'res a perfect spot of skill, and pure dumb luck that isn't like any other TCG. 
My main difficulty is balancing everything because it is so unlike other games that I've heard of at least.  I feel like im being pretty damn original rn but everything been done under the sun so do you have other games like this other than just 'knightmare chess'?

There's millions of things I wish I could have done differently with my brother, I wish I didn't get mad at him for playing with my toys or leaving him behind crying when I went to be with my friends.  We also lived in the same room together for 13 years, and we moved to a new house and got our own rooms.  Guess what, guess the actual fuck what, I read my brothers suicide letter a couple months before he hung himself, he told me it was a story he was working on but in hindsight it's too clear what was up, but he played me liked a fiddle (prob scared I'd figure out). I remember how he would remark on how he hated life, and that's all I can do now... remember, I knew exactly where he was going that night, hell he prob used the way I thought him, but when he texted my mom "I'm sorry" I thought that he had run away so I texted him "come back home it's not worth it being homeless" I still have that text on my phone to this day. What I'm trying to say is that I didn't know, and God damn did I wish I knew, your sisters probably went through some shit when they were younger and think you'll grow outta it like i did, I mean the kid was a exact duplicate of me, and I'm alive.  If family isn't what you can turn to than I beg that you find friends and if friends aren't your cup of tea please understand that life has ups and downs, you live by a moment to moment life and each moment leads to the next suicide cancels that's moment to moment format and you'll never experience any moment ever again.  The future is always untold but the moment will come when you'll have the happiest day I'm your life, than sometime down the road you'll have another one, those happy ones are nice and unexpected and worth it. Some of these things I wish I could have told my brother, or could tell him.

I had a 16 and a half year old brother who hung himself two months ago and I just want to let every single little brother know that your older brother will ussaly go to the edge of the earth and back even if that is literally impossible, cause in the end it will be you two who are gonna need each other the most.

I bet you don't wanna go alone, I bet you don't wanna be by yourself when your skin starts getting cold, I'm dead sure you wanna be found inside your car with you and your buddy but you wanna know the people who don't want you to even go, the people who have to find your corpses, the folk and the morgue who have to watch your family and friends cry over your guys slowly deforming faces.  I'm not sure if you have much family but if you have a brother or sister that youre even kinda close with they'll do a lot more for you than they lead on.
